component.name: Webkit-GN
component.summary: Write and format documents on the GNOME desktop

description.p: Webkit-GN is a native word processor for GNOME, with a floating formatting toolbar and a clean writing surface. Open and save self-contained HTML documents.
Format headings and paragraphs, work with tables, pictures and text boxes, arrange column sections, find and replace text, and print with a paginated PDF preview.
Set document margins in millimetres, saved with HTML and used for print preview and printing.
Use English for application, GTK and WebKit interface messages, preserving regional date and number settings.
Use the GNOME 51 Flatpak runtime and Twinly-compatible GTK 4.24/Wayland native blur requirements, enabling blur on menus and popovers.
Delete custom paragraph styles from the styles menu or style editor, with undo and built-in style fallback. Keep style menus accurate after undoing style changes.
Fix blur-backdrop alignment with GTK controls at different WebKit scales, including the Flatpak runtime.
